欢迎来到TDB（夜城，破晓，明光尽噬等等都是同名的一个MOD）我的朋友。

该mod仅能在1.6及其前置下使用。

这是一个由我的200余名OC角色所组成的MOD，包含数百个地图与剧情，信件，衣服，商店，食物，加工品等等等内容，独乐乐不如众乐乐，所以分享出来给大家一起玩。

该MOD以二次元风格为主体，与原版画风并不保持一致。

这是一处从公交车站台森林左上角可进入的若干个城市地图，拥有被分割的数百个小地图和探索的建筑物，村镇，部落，人物集群等。其中包含着部分主线剧情及其都带有个人线剧情的npc。

该Mod包括轻微暴力描写，轻微色情描写，非传统的爱情描写（例如SM等），对战争与死亡的描写，对酒精毒品滥用与性滥交的模糊提示，轻微恐怖向描写，原版人物轻微的性格不符，以上所有内容为默认关闭状态，若您介意这些内容或者未成年，不建议您游玩。

目前这并不是一个完全体MOD，还会进行长期更新，所以BUG和内容缺失是比较正常的。我会加速更新解决这些问题。

常见问题
Q:这是什么版本的破晓（夜城）MOD？
A:这是破晓（夜城）1.6版本的PC（电脑端）测试版MOD。它并不是最终版且存在诸多BUG与未完成内容，请根据个人情况选择下载。

Q:我该如何安装破晓（夜城）MOD？
A:请将群文件的1.6文件夹内的前置及破晓（夜城）本体拖入MOD文件夹。

Q:当我出现了红字（黄字）提示该怎么办？
A:请判断是否影响你的正常游戏，若不影响，请无视它，这是正常现象，我正在修改。

若影响游戏正常进行，请联系我的QQ 3120468991。QQ群 612647989
Q:破晓（夜城）的兼容性如何？
A:它与目前主流一切大型Mod（SVE,RSV,ES）与独立NPC兼容。个人精力有限无法确保也不打算特意令它和任何杂七杂八所有MOD都兼容，若有不兼容情况发生，不会特意进行兼容，若有不便尽情谅解。

Q:找不到路，迷路问题...
A:地图见群文件。小地图正在制作中。

Q:找不到某NPC，不知道NPC喜好，无法触发某NPC剧情？
A:见群文件及WIKI站（正在制作中）。现在暂时可以先自由探索。

Q:NPC对话奇怪，空对话，无剧情等情况？
A:这是正常的，目前而言并不是一个完整最终的MOD，我正在一直加速完善，尽情谅解。

Q:NPC头像模糊问题？
A:这是正常的，如果感觉奇怪可以使用群文件提供的高清头像前置夹。

Q:如果我不喜欢某NPC/某剧情/某地图该如何处理？
A:我为此感到遗憾，请按照我B站教程删掉ta或者ta的剧情。
每一个角色都是我的OC孩子，恕我不会正式随意删除某个角色。

Q:二改，二传，自编辑问题？
A:请随意将该MOD发布在任何其他公开合法的平台，例如微博，小红书，QQ群，百度网盘，或者私发给自己的朋友，可以私下将角色行走图及头像等更改为任何角色（不违反法律与基本道德的情况下。）禁止以任何方式冒充原作者或是售卖等盈利行为。

Welcome to TDB (Night City, Dawn, Bright Light, etc. are all named MODs), my friend.

This is a map of several cities that can be accessed from the upper left corner of the bus stop forest, with hundreds of segmented mini maps and explored buildings, villages, tribes, character clusters, etc. It includes some main storylines and NPCs with personal storylines.

(Note, this is a mod involving AI. Only including grammar spelling correction, code curly braces correction)If you are averse to the content involved in AI, Mark to prevent people who don't like AI from accidentally downloading and feeling uncomfortable > <

This is a MOD composed of over 200 OC characters, including hundreds of maps and plots, letters, clothes, shops, food, processed products, and more. Dule Le is not as good as Zhongle Le, so I share it with everyone to play together.

This MOD is based on the anime style, which is not consistent with the original painting style.

This Mod includes descriptions of mild violence, mild pornography, non-traditional love (such as SM,etc.), descriptions of war and death, vague hints about alcohol and drug abuse and sexual promiscuity, mild horror oriented descriptions, minor personality inconsistencies in the original characters,  and all of the above content are default closed. If you mind these contents or are underage, we do not recommend playing them.

At present, this is not a complete MOD and there will be long-term updates, so bugs and missing content are relatively normal. I will accelerate the updates to address these issues.

Frequently asked questions
Q: What version of Dawn (Night City) MOD is this?
A: This is the PC (computer side) test version MOD of Dawn (Night City) 1.6. It is not the final version and there are many bugs and unfinished
content. Please choose to download according to your personal situation.

Q: How should I install the Dawn (Night City) MOD?
A: Please drag the front and Dawn (Night City) entities from folder 1.6 of the group files into the MOD folder.

Q: What should I do when I receive a red (yellow) prompt?
A: Please check if it affects your normal game. If it doesn't, please ignore it. This is a normal phenomenon and I am currently making modifications.
If it affects the normal operation of the game, please contact my QQ 3120468991.

Q: How compatible is Dawn (Night City)?
A: It is compatible with all current mainstream large Mods (SVE, RSV, ES) and independent NPCs. Due to limited personal energy, I cannot guarantee or intend to make it compatible with any miscellaneous MODs. If any incompatibility occurs, I will not make it compatible. I apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Q: How should I enter Dawn (Night City)?
A: As shown in the figure, move up this time.

Q: Unable to find the way, getting lost problem
A: Map can be found in group files. The mini map is currently being made.

Q: Unable to find a certain NPC, unsure of NPC preferences, unable to trigger a certain NPC storyline?
A: See group files and WIKI website (currently under production). For now, you can freely explore.

Q: Strange NPC dialogue, empty dialogue, no plot, etc?
A: This is normal, currently it is not a complete and final MOD. I am constantly accelerating and improving it, fully understanding.

Q: NPC avatar blurry issue?
A: This is normal. If you feel strange, you can use the high-definition avatar front clip provided by the group file.

Q: What should I do if I don't like a certain NPC/plot/map?
A: I am sorry for this, please follow my Bilibili tutorial to delete it or its plot.
Each character is my OC child, and I will not officially delete any character at will.

Q: Second revision, second transmission, and self editing issues?
A: Please feel free to post this MOD on any other public and legal platforms, such as Weibo, Xiaohongshu, QQ groups, Baidu cloud storage, or privately send it to your friends. You can privately change the character's walking chart and avatar to any character (without violating the law and basic ethics). It is prohibited to impersonate the original author or engage in profit-making activities such as selling in any way.
